title: Newhalo product sub-navigation
description: A 60px graphite bar of in-page links for long product pages, with a lighter 'reserve →' segment at its right end. It fades in once the first screen is scrolled past and floats 10px above the bottom of the window; the section in view gets a short orange bar under its name. On phones it sits at the top and folds into a dropdown showing the current section.
notes: links point at section ids on the same page
always dark (wraps itself in .dark); needs JavaScript (hydrate: load)
